caption: The drawing depicts a metal trivet with a round, openwork surface comprised of interlacing curved bars forming a symmetrical pattern of loops within a circular frame. The trivet has three short cylindrical legs and an elongated handle ending in a heart-shaped loop. It is rendered in grayscale, depicting the object as a dark, iron-like material against a beige background. Above the main perspective drawing, there is a top-down view of the trivet and a side elevation showing its profile and legs, along with a small scale for reference. The main trivet is positioned in the lower half of the drawing, angled to display both the surface pattern and the handle. The artist's name, "G. Dorazzo," is written in the lower left corner.
title: Flat Iron Holder
